description: This is a controller class for handling the 'edit view' of AOS_Contracts within a SuiteCRM module. It manages data retrieval for related entities like quotes, accounts, contacts, and opportunities, and prepares the bean for display and editing.

classes.name: AOS_ContractsController
classes.description: Controller class extending SugarController to manage the edit view logic for AOS_Contracts.

methods.name: action_editview
methods.description: Prepares the edit view by fetching related quote, account, contact, and opportunity data based on request parameters and setting relevant properties on the bean.
